simplified.label: Studio simplified RSC
simplified.scope: Matches the existing studio. Blank length = joint + 2 × (internal length + internal width). Blank width = internal height + internal width. Each flap is half the internal width. There is no score allowance and no flap gap. This is not a universal factory formula.

converter.label: Demonstration converter allowance
converter.scope: A documented demonstration allowance, not a certified cutting die. It adds 1.5 mm at each of the four boundaries between wall panels, and shortens the pair of flaps by a 3 mm relief so they do not meet. Another converter's scores will differ.
